clock_ticks_provenance: Root provided frozen Linux SC_CLK_TCK=100; no live runtime read performed.

syncalias8.source_attribution_reason: No recorded barriers or timestamped proof checkpoints in exact synchronous control.

limits: This maps archived kernel/task samples to completed wait timestamps, not stdout arrival; buffered marker arrival was only a lower bound.
Sample start uses process boot ticks plus harness elapsed; spawn and clock bookkeeping are approximated within a conservative plus-or-minus1s interval.
Async batches contain up to8 proofs, and the checked wait includes kernel/codegen; no individual proof is identified as a memory culprit.
Sync source contains no barrier timestamps; do not borrow the bounded8 source progress mapping.
memory.stat cache/RSS are cgroup counters; they are not an exact decomposition of per-process PSS.
